releaseNotes:
- Live transcription is steadier during long speech, app switching, pauses, and noisy audio, with clearer download progress and safer recovery.
- Dictation can paste provisional text as you speak and preserve the session when focus moves between apps.
- Screen translation now streams results incrementally, fits translated text to the source, preserves source context, and keeps controls out of the content area.
- Translation and refinement requests fail over sooner when a provider connects but does not begin responding.
- Model defaults and retry chains now use the latest reviewed quality and latency results across Windows and Android.
- Result windows, processing contours, progress notifications, clipboard restore, and shortcut labels behave more consistently.
- Screen Recorder includes improved microphone selection, auto-stop sensitivity, paused waveform behavior, and shortcut hints.
- Downloaded components use tighter integrity checks, cleaner ownership, bounded development caching, and updated signed delivery contracts.
